name: uncounterable_gaeas_herald
note: Gaea's Herald: 'Creature spells can't be countered.' A static ability of the permanent, over every creature spell. P1's first Cancel resolves without countering P0's Goblin Piker, which enters; the second Cancel counters P0's Shock, which is not a creature spell (P1 stays at 20). Red on main dd4ba95: the sentence did not parse, so the Piker was countered. Converted 2026-11-11 to real priority (docs/DESIGN_PRIORITY.md): the response window is gone, so the answer is a spell cast while the first waits on the stack ("hold").
